_about: POCO X5 Pro 5G (redwood, Xiaomi, SM7325 / Snapdragon 778G): the donor's own device (HackiOS boots to SpringBoard on it). Filled from the donor's common/devices/redwood.conf (conf_bridge.py import), its SoC base DT prebuilt/uefi/redwood.dtb (extract_profile.py; board parts are in DTBO overlays, so touch/keys came from the donor drivers), and the donor drivers' redwood tables. Not measured by this project.
_status: donor: iOS userland on the phone over fastboot boot + USB (./xl); touch (FocalTech/Goodix over SPI), buttons, cpufreq (EPSS), Wi-Fi (WCN6750 + ath11k), GPU (Adreno 642L).

flash._note: Xiaomi has a real `fastboot boot`: the test image is sent to RAM and booted once; nothing on the phone is written. This is the safest entry method there is. The donor's ./xl does exactly this.
flash.enter_test: fastboot boot <image> (RAM only; the only fastboot verb besides getvar/reboot the toolkit allows)

download_mode.tool: Xiaomi EDL / MiFlash with the stock fastboot ROM
download_mode.note: only for a bricked phone; a fastboot-boot test cannot brick it

baseline._note: fastboot-boot writes nothing, so no restore is needed; record boot/vbmeta hashes anyway to prove they never change

bootimg._note: the donor's mkxnuimg.py builds the fastboot-boot image (BootShim + FD + payload) with mkbootimg

log_ring._note: the donor logs over its USB link (./xl log) and a log partition, not a RAM ring

log_slot._note: not needed: the loader's USB link carries the log

gic._note: runs under Qualcomm's Gunyah hypervisor with a standard virtual GIC: the timer is at 27

kernel.overlay_dir: the donor's xnu/files (redwood is its default)

firmware.package: donor uefi/: Mu-Silicium redwood (follows lisa, the same SoC package)

touch._sources: donor bsd/dev/redwood_goodix.c; registers cross-checked with socs/sc7280.json (engine 0xa94000 = QUPv3 wrap1 SE5)
touch.compatible: goodix,gt9916 / focaltech,ft3680 (two panel variants; GPIO96=1 and GPIO68=0 mean FocalTech)
touch.transport: geni-fifo SPI, or bit-banged if the engine cannot be used

battery._note: not in the donor's profile; read the live DT (PM7325B qgauge / an I2C gauge)

wifi.status: donor: WCN6750 + ath11k (WPSS DSP loaded through TrustZone)

userland._note: ./xl ramdisk userland/system.apfs sends it over the loader's USB link
